evidence.type: Uncalibrated mass-energy-cost comparisons; no performance prediction

budget.note: Inherited pretax hypothetical envelope, not a quote; 2% is a purchased replacement assumption, never an environmental release allowance. Equipment tax-inclusive JPY200M requirement is separate and unproven.

latent_comparison.notes: Hypothetical latent-only resistance-heater comparison. No sensible heat, fans, process losses, heat recovery, dewatering or capital; not universal cost floor.

formation.notes: All density/packing values are design assumptions, not measured powder/grain properties. One droplet -> one sphere mass identity, not atomization prediction.

peclet.notes: Illustrative equation audit. Primary preprint calls 180 nm particle radius after defining droplet radius. Actual droplet radius and evolving gel diffusion unresolved.

buffer.notes: Assumed inventory and off-line schedule only, no handling or drying rate validated.
